rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Detects and obfuscates sensitive data before it reaches AI assistants using 19 regex pattern types and BERT-based Named Entity Recognition. Maintains a bidirectional mapping table for lossless round-trip obfuscation, supporting IPs, hostnames, emails, API keys, person names, organizations, locations, private keys, and connection strings. Includes an HTTP proxy tool for making real requests with automatic deobfuscation/reobfuscation and JSONL audit logging for compliance.
